The kind 'same' requires the same literal on the Mac line and in the phone case's code. What is left needs a device: every live case of checks/searchphone-check.py runs against the iPhone on the iOS 26.5 simulator at 402x874, a runtime this Mac does not have (proof 4). | Round 2 (iphone-rig, 2026-11-12): the iOS 26.5 runtime is installed and scripts/iphone-rig.sh runs the phone with no window (docs/lanes/iphone-rig.md); the lead proofs below are the exact commands through it.
